title: [2.8.2.2-Dev] Insulin boluses and carbohydrates not syncing with xDrip +
body:
Reporting bugs
--------------
When you add a treatment from the calculator, the data is synced correctly in Nightscout, however it is not synced with xDrip +.  No carbohydrate or bolus treatment is displayed in xDrip +.
![Screenshot_20210625-085127](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67511778/123382809-a976aa80-d592-11eb-845b-5a5877a1980c.jpg)
![Screenshot_20210625-085135](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67511778/123382816-aa0f4100-d592-11eb-9106-a3ecada9d498.jpg)
![Screenshot_20210625-085147](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67511778/123382818-aaa7d780-d592-11eb-9bcc-5c547af38143.jpg)

Version: 2.8.2.2-Dev Build 33047e478

comments.body: SMBs are also not displayed in xDrip +.  All this with version 2.8.2 worked without any problem

hopefully fixed by https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/272cdbbb0010a1acd9043de3629ce8131ef2d44b
remember it's still broadcasting only NSClient data ie only what is comming from NS

not fixed unfortunately (in todays dev version). 
xDrip always received treatments (smb, bolus, carb and even notes if I'not mistaken) directly from AAPS.

not sure what you @MilosKozak mean with 'only what is coming **from** NS'. I have both xDrip and AAPS configured to only uploadto  (and not dowload from) NS. To be able to have my system running not require an internet connection.
It doesn't work for me either after recompiling the app
sorry i was wrong. there was never direct AAPS -> xDrip broadcast. up to version 2.8.2 NSClient did broadcast data comming from NS. With new NSClient this functionality was removed
